entities.summary: Jacob Hollister is an American professional football tight end. He played college football at Wyoming and signed with the New England Patriots as an undrafted free agent in 2017. Hollister has also been a member of the Seattle Seahawks, Buffalo Bills, Jacksonville Jaguars, Las Vegas Raiders, and Minnesota Vikings.
